 Ricky Sandler - Evolution of Long-Short Equity Investing (EP.414) 
 
 Ricky Sandler - Evolution of Long-Short Equity Investing (EP.414) Oct 28, 2024

 Ricky Sandler is one of the OGs of fundamental long-short equity
investing. Ricky started managing a hedge fund thirty years ago and
founded Eminence Capital a few years later. Today, he is the CEO
and CIO at Eminence, where he oversees $7 billion across
long-short, long-only, and long-extension strategies.

 

Our conversation covers Ricky’s path to launching Eminence in his
twenties and the evolution of long-short investing in the decades
since. We dive into Eminence's culture, adaptation in the
investment process, and creation of investment products to meet the
needs of allocators, each of which has been an essential part of
the firm’s ability to survive and thrive amid changing market
dynamics.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
